muted.usage: Scanned text: dates, meta lines, labels, hints, inactive nav, icons at rest; 50% for the resting nav line.

line.usage: Every 1px hairline, the secondary button edge, the scrollbar thumb. Decorative contrast only.

hover.usage: The only fill: under the pointer on work rows, contact rows, secondary button.

shadows.name: hairline-inset

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every arrival: entrance, row open, row content, icon rotation, nav line width, language crossfade. CSS var --ease-out.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover and press state changes (Tailwind default timing).

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 700ms ease-out both; from opacity 0, translateY(8px), blur(2px); delay calc(var(--i) * 70ms + 80ms)

motion.name: row-open
motion.purpose: Work row panel opening in place.

motion.name: row-content-in
motion.value: opacity 360ms ease-out, transform translateY(6px) to 0 420ms ease-out, delay calc(var(--i) * 45ms + 90ms)

motion.name: row-content-out
motion.value: opacity and transform 160ms ease, no delay
motion.purpose: Panel blocks leaving at once on close.

motion.name: row-icon
motion.purpose: Plus becomes a close mark when the row opens.

motion.name: nav-line
motion.purpose: Section nav line: 32px rest, 48px hover, 64px active.

motion.name: state-fill
motion.purpose: Button and row fills, 0.97 press scale, 2px arrow nudges.

motion.name: state-text
motion.purpose: Muted-to-ink text and icon color shifts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll off; rise, row panel, row content, row icon and nav line set to animation/transition none; row content forced visible; view-transition navigation none. Utility-level hover fills, press scale and arrow nudges are not covered.

narrative.overview:
The site is an index, not a showcase. Off-white paper, soft-black ink, hairline rules and a single grotesk family carry every screen; the only color is a deep cane green taken from the sugar-cane fields of the Valle del Cauca, and it appears only where something can be acted on or is currently true. Nothing sits on a card, nothing casts a shadow, and no single project is staged as a hero. Hierarchy comes from three weight steps, a handful of sizes and the split between ink and muted text, never from surfaces.

The page is dense in content and sparse in apparatus. On desktop a sticky identity column (name, role, intro, section nav, actions, availability) stays put while a reading column of hairline-separated lists scrolls beside it: the work index, the process steps, the experience timeline, the stack groups, the contact rows. Every list is row-based, and detail lives one click deep inside the row that names it, not on another page or in a modal. On phones the same stack runs in one column and the section nav is dropped.

Motion follows the owner's standing preference: clean, minimal, few animations, each one well made. There is one staggered entrance for the identity column, rows that open in place, a nav line that grows to mark the current section, a crossfade when the language changes, and 2px arrow nudges on hover. Everything that arrives uses one strong ease-out curve; everything that leaves is shorter. Confirmed rejections from the direction contract: hero banners, card grids, metric tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink and one green; the green marks interaction and live state only.
1px hairline rules are the only structure; no shadows, no cards, no panels at rest.
One family (Schibsted Grotesk) in three weights, stylistic set 01 everywhere, tabular figures for years and dates.
Sticky identity column beside a scrolling index; a single column on phones.
Work rows expand in place instead of linking out to case-study pages.
Strong ease-out for arrivals, short plain fades for exits, all of it off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Open Slow, Close Fast Rule
rules.body: Arrivals take their time on the ease-out curve (420ms row, 700ms entrance); departures are cut short (220ms collapse, 160ms content fade) so nothing lingers after the reader is done with it.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Cane green marks what can be acted on or what is currently true: links, focus, the active section, availability, and an icon under the pointer. It never fills a surface, never tints a heading, never decorates. There is no second accent.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy in text is ink for what is read and muted for what is scanned (dates, organizations, labels, hints). The only intermediate is ink at 80% for work-row summaries.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 is for reading, 500 for labels and values, 600 for names and titles. Nothing is set at 700 or heavier, nothing lighter than 400.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every year, date range and step number is set in tabular figures and in muted, so columns of time align down the page.

rules.name: The Bleed Rule
rules.body: Interactive rows extend their hover fill 16px past the text column on both sides (negative margin, matching padding), so text stays flush with the hairlines and the fill reads as a highlight, not a box.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A surface may change tone under the pointer; it never lifts, never casts, and never sits in a box at rest.

dos: Do draw every list as hairline rows (1px `line`, closed top and bottom) and keep a row's detail inside that row, expanding in place.
Do keep cane green to links, focus, the active nav line, the availability dot and icons under the pointer; selection and caret use its wash and its hue.
Do set years, date ranges and step numbers in muted tabular figures.
Do use the ease-out curve (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`) for anything that arrives, and make exits shorter than entrances (open 420ms, close 220ms).
Do add every new motion class to the `prefers-reduced-motion` block, leaving content fully visible and the interaction working without tweening.
Do bleed hover fills 16px past the text column with the 12px row radius, so text stays flush with the rules.
Do pair every icon with a visible text label: 16px Lucide outline, GitHub as its filled mark.
Do define any new color for both themes by role, and keep `theme-color` equal to `paper` and `paper-dark`.
donts: Don't cast shadows or place content on cards or tinted panels at rest; the only fill is Pressed Paper, under the pointer.
Don't build hero banners, card grids or metric tiles; figures stay inside sentences.
Don't introduce a second accent, a gradient, or a second typeface.
Don't set type at 700 or heavier.
Don't animate the content column on load or on scroll; the identity column's single entrance is the only load motion.
Don't use the accent on headings, fills or decoration.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers above section titles; a hint line, when needed, goes under the title in muted Meta.
